content.heading: Provincial Small Cause Courts
content.text: The following provisions of this Code shall not extend to Courts constituted under the Provincial Small Cause Courts Act, 1887, or under the Berar Small Cause Courts Law, 1905, except as provided by those enactments: so much of the body of the Code as relates to appeals from decrees, execution against immovable property, and the other excluded heads listed in Section 7. Read the official list.
